title: Log Roll and T-Balance
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 1 Creative Activities; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Activities teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Mats or soft grass. Markers from bottle tops or leaves. The teacher shows and supports every roll and balance.

skills.key_step: The child says a log roll is a straight sideways roll and a T-balance is standing on one leg with the body and arms making a T.
steps: Log roll: lie straight, arms up, roll sideways.
Lean forward, lift the other leg back.

board.do: Wait for: out to the sides.
How many feet on the ground?

misconceptions.ask: In a log roll, is your body straight or curled?
misconceptions.repair: Lie straight like a log and roll.

misconceptions.ask: Which way does a log roll go?
misconceptions.repair: Roll a real log or a bottle along the floor.

misconceptions.ask: In a T-balance, how many feet are on the ground?
misconceptions.repair: Hold a wall and lift one leg back.

misconceptions.ask: In a T-balance, where are your arms?
misconceptions.repair: Make a letter T with your arms out.

checks.question: Which way does a log roll go?
How many feet do you stand on in a T-balance?
